name: Corporate Action Event Stage 3 Code
definition: Specifies the stage of the CA event.

APPD.name: Approved
APPD.definition: Approved at the relevant meeting, for example, dividend.

FULL.name: Cancellation And Re Run
FULL.definition: Cancellation and re-run of an original lottery or an original and supplemental lottery. A subsequent lottery will be performed under a new event.

LAPS.name: Lapsed
LAPS.definition: Event/offer conditions have not been met and the event/offer is terminated or lapsed.

PART.name: Supplemental Cancellation And Re Run
PART.definition: Cancellation and re-run of a supplemental lottery only. A subsequent new supplemental lottery will be performed under the original event.

PWAL.name: Action Period
PWAL.definition: Open for acceptance until the next specified deadline in the announcement (if any).

RESC.name: Supplemental Cancellation
RESC.definition: A supplemental lottery is being cancelled by the issuer. No subsequent lottery will be performed.

SUAP.name: Subject To Approval
SUAP.definition: Subject to approval at the relevant meeting, for example, dividend.

UNAC.name: Unconditional As To Acceptance
UNAC.definition: The required level of acceptances specified in the terms of the offer has been achieved but there are still outstanding conditions to fulfil.

WHOU.name: Wholly Unconditional
WHOU.definition: Wholly unconditional; all conditions specified in the offer document have been satisfied.
